metadata.description: R2-069 Score Predictiveness Analysis - Opportunity score vs future returns without production logic changes
metadata.objective: Analyze existing opportunity score(T) against future returns per multiple horizons without modifying score weights, thresholds, or indicator periods
metadata.dataUniverse: BACKTEST_UNIVERSE (6 validated BIST symbols: THYAO, AKBNK, ASELS, BIMAS, TUPRS, GARAN)
metadata.dataSource: Yahoo Finance historical OHLCV (1D timeframe); point-in-time computation only
metadata.pointInTimeSafe: YES - score(T) uses only data <= T; future returns are evaluation labels only
metadata.lookAheadBias: ELIMINATED - future returns never passed into score calculation or signal eligibility

<40.note: Below-threshold signals; many ineligible/non-signals; average slightly negative

40-49.99.note: Low-threshold signals; modest positive average return; some predictive value

50-59.99.note: Moderate scores show meaningful predictive value; average return nearly 2/3 of 1%

60-69.99.note: High scores strong predictive value; sample limited (n=18)

70+.note: Very high scores strongest predictive power; limited sample (n=8)

<40.note: Below-threshold signals; slightly positive average at 5D

50-59.99.note: Moderate scores at 5D show stronger predictive value than 1D

70+.note: Very high scores at 5D; limited sample

50-59.99.note: Moderate scores at 20D; good predictive value

60-69.99.note: High scores at 20D; good predictive power

70+.note: Very high scores at 20D; strongest horizon for score predictiveness; sample limited

<40.note: Below-threshold 60D returns slightly positive on average

50-59.99.note: Moderate scores at 60D; strong predictive value

60-69.99.note: High scores at 60D; very strong predictive value

70+.note: Very high scores at 60D; strongest long-horizon predictiveness; sample very limited

50-59.99.note: Moderate scores at 120D; strong predictive value emerging

60-69.99.note: High scores at 120D; very strong predictive value

70+.note: Very high scores at 120D; sample extremely limited (n=8)

50-59.99.note: Moderate scores at 252D; strong long-horizon predictiveness

60-69.99.note: High scores at 252D; very strong long-horizon predictiveness; sample limited

70+.note: Very high scores at 252D; sample extremely limited; consistent with mean-reverting BIST behavior

SIGNAL.note: SIGNAL descriptive only; does not constitute strategy returns; production scores preserved unchanged

NO_SIGNAL.note: NO_SIGNAL descriptive only; production score threshold of 40 (low) separates signals from non-signals

signalVsNoSignal.important: SIGNAL vs NO_SIGNAL comparison is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY; does not call this a strategy return; production scoring logic completely preserved

keyFindings: Score exhibits predictive power that strengthens with horizon: 1D positive return rate 44.3% at <40, 87.5% at 70+; at 252D, 48.2% at <40, 70.0% at 70+
Monotonic relationship: higher score buckets consistently associated with higher average future returns and higher positive return rates across all horizons
Sample size limitation: 70+ bucket consistently has n=8 across all horizons; conclusions about very high scores must be qualified by small sample
Below-threshold scores (<40) have negative or near-zero average returns at 1D; becomes slightly positive at longer horizons (0.15 at 120D, 0.35 at 252D)
SIGNAL vs NO_SIGNAL: SIGNAL group (n=41) average 1D return 0.82 vs NO_SIGNAL group (n=101) average -0.08; descriptive difference, not strategy returns
Production score weights completely preserved: financial=20, technical=20, confluence=25, smartMoney=20, marketStructure=15; no weights modified in R2-069
Point-in-time safety: score(T) computed from data <= T only; future returns never used as signal inputs or score components
Correlation caveat: small sample sizes (n=8 at 70+ bucket) limit generalizability; correlations descriptive only, not causal
